# The Globe and Mail

> > Canada's national newspaper covering breaking news, politics, international affairs, business, and culture with authoritative journalism.

The Globe and Mail is Canada's foremost news publication, providing comprehensive coverage of domestic and international events with a focus on Canadian perspectives on global affairs. The site features video content, in-depth reporting, and analysis across politics, defense, and world news.

## Key Topics

- Canadian Politics
- Mark Carney
- Arctic Defence
- Middle East Conflict
- Iran Leadership
- Mojtaba Khamenei
- U.S.-Iran Relations
- Donald Trump
- Pete Hegseth
- Canadian Foreign Policy
- Military Assistance
- Defense Policy
- International Relations
- Supreme Leader Succession

## Canadian Politics & Defence

- [Carney announces $32-billion for Arctic defence](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/video-carney-announces-32-billion-for-arctic-defence): PM Carney unveils $32B Arctic military investment for northern bases
- [Carney says military has not been asked to help in Middle East](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/video-carney-says-military-has-not-been-asked-to-help-in-middle-east): PM Carney confirms no Middle East military assistance request in Tokyo
